query_changes.description: Searches for CLs matching a given query string.

gerrit_base_url.description: The base URL of the Gerrit instance. This is configured via the gerrit_config.json file or the GERRIT_BASE_URL environment variable.

query.description: The search query string, using standard Gerrit search operators.

limit.description: The maximum number of changes to return.

options.description: A list of additional data fields to return (e.g., ["LABELS", "DETAILED_ACCOUNTS"]).

get_change_details.description: Retrieves a comprehensive summary of a single CL.

options.description: A list of additional data fields to return (e.g., ["MESSAGES", "DETAILED_ACCOUNTS"]).

get_commit_message.description: Gets the full commit message of a change from the current patch set.

gerrit_base_url.description: The base URL of the Gerrit instance. This is configured via the GERRIT_BASE_URL environment variable, which defaults to https://fuchsia-review.googlesource.com/.

list_change_files.description: Lists all files modified in the most recent patch set of a CL.

gerrit_base_url.description: The base URL of the Gerrit instance. This is configured via the gerrit_config.json file or the GERRIT_BASE_URL environment variable.

get_file_diff.description: Retrieves the diff for a single, specified file within a CL.

gerrit_base_url.description: The base URL of the Gerrit instance. This is configured via the gerrit_config.json file or the GERRIT_BASE_URL environment variable.

file_path.description: The full path of the file to retrieve the diff for.

list_change_comments.description: Fetches all published comments for a CL, grouped into threads.

gerrit_base_url.description: The base URL of the Gerrit instance. This is configured via the gerrit_config.json file or the GERRIT_BASE_URL environment variable.

add_reviewer.description: Adds a user or a group to a CL as either a reviewer or a CC.

gerrit_base_url.description: The base URL of the Gerrit instance. This is configured via the gerrit_config.json file or the GERRIT_BASE_URL environment variable.

reviewer.description: The email address of the user or the name of the group to add.

state.description: The role to assign. Either 'REVIEWER' or 'CC'. Defaults to 'REVIEWER'.

get_most_recent_cl.description: Gets the most recent CL for a user.

gerrit_base_url.description: The base URL of the Gerrit instance. This is configured via the gerrit_config.json file or the GERRIT_BASE_URL environment variable.

get_bugs_from_cl.description: Extracts bug IDs from the commit message of a CL.

message.description: An optional message to include with the abandonment.

post_review_comment.description: Posts a review comment in a CL: on a line, on a whole file, or on the whole patch set.

gerrit_base_url.description: The base URL of the Gerrit instance. This is configured via the gerrit_config.json file or the GERRIT_BASE_URL environment variable.

file_path.description: The full path of the file to comment on, or /PATCHSET_LEVEL. With in_reply_to, it is taken from the parent comment, and when given it must be the parent's.

line_number.description: The line number to post the comment on. Without it, the comment goes on the whole file. With in_reply_to, it is taken from the parent comment, and when given it must be the parent's.

labels.description: A dictionary of labels to apply to the review (e.g., {'Verified': 1}).

in_reply_to.description: The ID of a published comment to reply to. The reply goes where that comment is: on its patch set, file, and line.

post_review_comments.description: Posts multiple review comments on a CL as a single, atomic review.

gerrit_base_url.description: The base URL of the Gerrit instance. This is configured via the gerrit_config.json file or the GERRIT_BASE_URL environment variable.

comments.description: The comments to post. Each item is an object with 'message' (string) and optionally 'file_path' (string), 'line_number' (number), 'unresolved' (boolean, default true) and 'in_reply_to' (string), as for post_review_comment. 'file_path' is required unless 'in_reply_to' is given.

message.description: An optional top-level review message shown on the change.

labels.description: A dictionary of labels to apply to the review (e.g., {'Code-Review': 1}).
